topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: Well now, this is a fine turn of events, just what we needed. The walls of our home, once walls of rent, now have roots, like the sturdy oak that shelters us from the worst of the storms. It’s as if the harvest has come early, a bounty we didn’t plant but have come to reap. The lord of the manor sees fit to grant us a piece of the land, so to speak. No more will we fear the sudden whims of a landlord like a sudden frost. We’ll have a say, a stake in the soil. This is a good day, a day to raise a cup to St. Christopher, our patron in such travels. May the earth indeed bear us fruit.
